notes: Chosen to fill the 'monorepo' coverage cell. arjanjohan/scaffold-move is a Scaffold-ETH-style Yarn-workspaces monorepo (packages/common, packages/move, packages/nextjs); only packages/nextjs is a Next.js app (app router), on a single next version, so scan_repo has no ambiguous-version question. PR #43 'upgrade next 14.2.28 -> 15.5.27 (security)' bumps the packages/nextjs manifest range from ^14.0.4 to ^15.5.24. The installed versions are the yarn.lock pins, not those ranges: 14.2.28 at base and 15.5.27 at merge. An earlier record used 14.0.4 and 15.5.24 from the manifest ranges, written when the re-checker did not read yarn.lock; both are now the lockfile pins so ingest does not raise version_mismatch. Picked over TAG-IT-NETWORK/tagit-dashboard #63, which was rejected as a case because its monorepo mixes next 14.2.35 (five apps) and 16.1.0 (apps/demo) at base, so scan_repo raises an ambiguous_version question that the derive-truth tooling cannot answer (recorded here as the reason for the swap). The merge commit has two parents (a true merge commit); base_commit is its first parent, which satisfies the parentage check.
